source.description: A reviewed six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet showing one consistent barn owl progressing from pale construction to a restrained graphite and colored-pencil finish.
source.notes: Keep one front-facing barn owl with its head tilted slightly toward the viewer's left, a heart-shaped facial disk, two dark eyes, one small hooked beak, two folded wings, two taloned feet gripping one weathered square fence post, a low grass line, and one broken shadow stable. No extra bird, branch, moon, stars, barn, text, labels, arrows, numbers, signature, watermark, or final-only anatomy.

process_strategy: Lock the owl's head tilt, body egg, folded-wing routes, feet, post top, grass, and shadow in pale construction; establish the full silhouette and every facial and feather landmark before shading; then add only graphite, warm tan, muted rust, and cream pencil to the forms already present.

final_elements.name: head oval, body egg, center axis, wing routes, feet, post, grass, and shadow guides
final_elements.description: Pale graphite construction fixes one slight head tilt, a centered body, two folded-wing paths, two foot placements, one square post, a low grass line, and one broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: complete owl silhouette, heart-shaped facial disk, two folded wings, and post top
final_elements.description: The outside contour, heart-shaped face, folded wings, and weathered post top turn the guides into one readable perched barn owl.

final_elements.name: two eyes, one hooked beak, brow planes, and two taloned feet
final_elements.description: Two dark eye openings, a small hooked beak, simple brow planes, and both gripping feet establish the owl's anatomy and alert expression.

final_elements.name: facial feather rays, wing feather groups, chest marks, post grain, grass, and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Broad feather rhythms and a few material marks add species character and ground the owl without over-rendering the plumage.

final_elements.name: graphite plumage values, warm-tan and muted-rust pencil, cream highlights, and deeper grounding tone
final_elements.description: Directional graphite and restrained colored pencil separate the facial disk, wings, chest, talons, wood, grass, and shadow while preserving paper tooth.

rejection_checks: The same front-facing owl, slight leftward head tilt, body size, folded-wing routes, foot placement, post crop, grass line, and shadow footprint must persist through all six panels.
Exactly one owl, one heart-shaped facial disk, two eyes, one beak, two folded wings, two taloned feet, and one fence post must appear before the final panel and persist.
No extra bird, branch, moon, stars, barn, scenery, text, label, arrow, number, signature, watermark, or final-only anatomy may appear.

The finish must retain visible graphite and colored-pencil grain rather than photoreal feathers, glossy eyes, airbrushed shading, or vector-like linework, and every dark pre-final line must survive unless it is a pale erasable guide.
